title: Tutoring Registration Form
subtitle: An original operational registration for tutoring that connects identity, evidence, authority, exceptions, privacy, and accountable closeout.
description: This Tutoring Registration Form supports the complete tutoring workflow from intake and routing through evidence, authorized decisions, exception ownership, qualified review, and final handoff.
use_case: Use the Tutoring Registration Form when the assigned tutoring coordinator needs one fillable record for learner goals, session routing, academic evidence, support, and release without inventing legal, medical, safety, consent, certification, or professional authority.

sections.title: Tutoring registration identity and routing
sections.guidance: Connect this registration to one learner goals, session routing, academic evidence, support, and release record, an accountable owner, and the current review route.

blocks.label: Tutoring record reference
blocks.guidance: Use the approved roster or case reference rather than creating a second identity.

blocks.label: Participant and responsible route
blocks.guidance: Record references and routing information only; keep sensitive details in approved systems.

blocks.label: Tutoring scope, trigger, prior handoff, and known limitations

fields.label: Scope, trigger, prior handoff, and known limitations

sections.title: Tutoring registration intake and requested placement
sections.guidance: Capture one requested program assignment, schedule, and accountable enrollment route.

blocks.label: Tutoring registration information
items: Subject, course, skill area, tutor, and requested schedule
Learner school, grade, and roster or referral reference
Guardian or school contact and communication route
Learning goal, assignment source, and evidence baseline
Approved academic accommodation or support-plan source
Accessibility, language, sensory, or communication support
Arrival, virtual identity, pickup, or departure arrangement
Materials, technology, start conditions, and case owner

blocks.label: Schedule, arrival, departure, routing, and owner
Registration goal, source, participant needs, and requested outcome

fields.label: Goal, source, participant needs, and requested outcome

blocks.label: Registration boundary
blocks.guidance: This form records tutoring operations; it does not diagnose learning needs, change a school plan, promise academic outcomes, decide custody, or replace emergency services. Stop or escalate when identity, guardian or school direction, approved support, release, privacy, or safety is unresolved. Record objective learning evidence and route educational or professional decisions to authorized qualified reviewers.

sections.title: Tutoring contacts, release route, and support readiness
sections.guidance: Route sensitive health and support information to its approved record and reviewer.

blocks.label: Registration readiness and stop conditions
items: Learner, tutor, subject, or session assignment is unclear
Guardian or school contact route is unavailable
Requested goal exceeds the tutoring program scope
Approved academic or accessibility support is unavailable
Learner is missing, distressed, ill, injured, or needs immediate support
Private school record or personal information is exposed
Pickup, independent departure, or virtual-session identity is unclear
Attendance, progress evidence, or follow-up record does not reconcile

blocks.label: Support or record source, applicability, owner, and status
Minimum-necessary information, access limits, assumptions, and open questions

fields.label: Information boundary, access limits, assumptions, and open questions

sections.title: Tutoring placement, readiness, and authorization decision
sections.guidance: Separate requested placement from authorized placement and retained conditions.

blocks.label: Tutoring readiness evidence
items: Learner is assigned to the correct tutor, subject, and session
Guardian or school referral and contact route is current
Learning goals and source materials are identified
Baseline evidence is described without diagnosing the learner
Attendance, arrival, and departure plan is recorded
Academic accommodations are used only from an approved source
Accessibility, language, sensory, or communication supports are routed
Confidential student records have minimum-necessary access
Tutor boundaries, escalation contact, and session setting are known
Open scheduling or learning-plan conditions have owners

blocks.label: Requested element, review result, condition, owner, and evidence
Tutoring registration decision
blocks.guidance: Record the authorized decision under current policy; this form does not grant authority to the preparer. Route uncertainty to the tutoring coordinator, guardian or school contact, and qualified support reviewer.

blocks.label: Placement rationale, alternatives, limits, and participant or guardian communication

sections.title: Tutoring onboarding, exceptions, and first-day handoff
sections.guidance: Turn each unresolved condition into an owned action before participation begins.

blocks.label: Registration exception indicators
items: Tutoring assignment or session cannot proceed as planned
Guardian, school, emergency contact, or release route is incomplete
Academic goal or requested service exceeds program authority
Approved accommodation, technology, or support is unavailable
Immediate illness, distress, missing-learner, or safety response is active
Attendance, progress, departure, or follow-up remains unresolved

blocks.label: Condition, required action, owner, due point, and acceptance
Onboarding and first-day handoff
items: Authorized assignment and schedule communicated
Arrival, attendance, and departure routes visible
Guardian and emergency communication routes available
Approved health and support records routed privately
Open condition has an owner and due point
First review date and completion evidence identified

sections.title: Tutoring outcome, closeout, and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Make the final outcome, remaining limitation, next action, owner, and recipient visible.

blocks.label: Tutoring closeout controls
items: Session attendance and learning evidence accepted
Guardian or school communication status recorded
Unresolved academic or support action has an owner
Equipment and private student records returned
Schedule, technology, or program follow-up linked
Tutoring record stored with access and retention requirements
blocks.guidance: Check only completed controls; preserve unresolved work as an open action.

blocks.label: Outcome verification, recipient acceptance, and reopen decision
Remaining limitation, action, owner, due point, and recipient route
blocks.guidance: Keep unresolved work visible until an accountable recipient accepts it.

blocks.label: Unresolved work, child or participant impact, evidence location, and handoff message

fields.label: Unresolved work, impact, evidence location, and handoff message

blocks.label: Registration closeout acknowledgment
blocks.guidance: Acknowledgment records preparation and receipt; it is not legal consent, medical certification, or professional approval.
